question: Do they report results only on English data?
title: When to reply? Context Sensitive Models to Predict Instructor Interventions in MOOC Forums
answer_rationale: The evaluation corpus is sourced from Coursera, an English-language platform, and all data is derived from its MOOC discussion forums, which are in English. The documents explicitly state that the data is from Coursera.org and that the evaluation is conducted on this English-language corpus.
